entries.title: Zechariah 10:1
segments: ¶Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; [so] the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field. {bright...: or, lightnings}

entries.title: Zechariah 10:2
segments: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because [there was] no shepherd. {idols: Heb. teraphims} {were...: or, answered that, etc}

words.text: . {idols: Heb. teraphims} {were...: or, answered that, etc}

entries.title: Zechariah 10:3
segments: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle. {punished: Heb. visited upon}

entries.title: Zechariah 10:4
segments: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:5
segments: ¶And they shall be as mighty [men], which tread down [their enemies] in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the LORD [is] with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded. {the riders...: or, they shall make the riders on horses ashamed}

words.text: . {the riders...: or, they shall make the riders on horses ashamed}

entries.title: Zechariah 10:6
segments: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I [am] the LORD their God, and will hear them.

words.text: , and I will bring them again to place
upon them: and they shall be as though
I had not cast them off

entries.title: Zechariah 10:7
segments: And [they of] Ephraim shall be like a mighty [man], and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see [it], and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:8
segments: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:9
segments: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:10
segments: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and [place] shall not be found for them.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:11
segments: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:12
segments: And I will strengthen them in the LORD; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the LORD.

words.text: ; and they shall walk up and down
